evals.prompt:
Run a manual continuous-monitoring pass for the topic 'example-okf-mif-knowledge-spine' and report whether it did any work.

Run:

  bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/packs/monitoring/continuous-monitor/scripts/run-monitoring.sh" example-okf-mif-knowledge-spine "run-manual-eval-1"

The script checks two independent gates before doing anything: harness.config.json packs[] must have a "continuous-monitor" entry with enabled:true, AND the topic's own continuousMonitoring.enabled must be true. In the bundled harness.config.json, the pack ships disabled by default, so this run should exit 0 having done nothing and print a message naming which gate is off.
evals.expected_output: The command exits 0 and prints a message stating the 'continuous-monitor' pack is not enabled in harness.config.json packs[] -- the bundled config ships the pack disabled by default, and the master pack gate is checked before the topic-level continuousMonitoring block, so nothing else runs.

deterministic_checks.description: The pipeline orchestrator ships at its new pack path
